limitations: A Current Maintainer can exempt a component from a condition by a clear statement in its copyright notice. Work identity, maintainer status, exemptions and other clause 6 conditions require separate assessment.
reasoning: For a non-Current Maintainer distributing a Derived Work, applicable clause 6(d) requires at least one of two things with the distribution: the complete unmodified Work or information sufficient to obtain it. Qualifying equivalent access satisfies the copy option.
